Court No. - 81
Case :- Transfer Application (Criminal) No. - 801 of 2023

Applicant :- Farjana Begam
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Ansar Ahmad,Sandhya Chaturvedi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.

Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Anees Beg, learned counsel for opposite party.
This is second transfer application.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that a Case No.407 of 2022 arising out of Case Crime No.177 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 323 IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act,
Police Station Rasoolpur, District Firozabad is pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Firozabad.

The applicant being a woman faces difficulty in attending the court proceedings at Firozabad, therefore requests to transfer the case from Firozabad to Auraiyya where other cases between the parties were pending.
Farjana Begam vs State Of U.P. And Another on 13 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110803688/

sentences.text: 1 Learned counsel for the opposite party opposed the prayer aforesaid and contended that it is State case and prosecution is conducted by the learned prosecutor.
The attendance of the applicant is not required on each and every date.
She is to attend the Court proceedings only for the purpose of evidence when summoned by the learned trial court.
First transfer application was rejected by this Court on the same ground.
Again this application has been moved only for making harassment of opposite parties who is husband, old mother-in-law, father-in-law and brother-in-law.

Considering the facts and circumstance of the case submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties as well as perusal of record, it appears that in this case the attendance of the applicant is required only for the purpose of evidence before the learned court when she will be summoned.
On the other hand, opposite party with other members of the family is to appear before the learned trial court on each and every date unless and until exempted by the learned trial court.
There will be more inconvenience to the opposite parties than that of the applicant, in case, the case is transferred from Firozabad to Auraiyya.
As a result, there appears no ground to transfer the present case.

Accordingly, this transfer application is disposed of with the liberty to the applicant to apply under Rules for Video Conferencing for Courts in the State of Uttar Pradesh, 2020 for video conference facility in judicial proceedings.

It is hereby provided that in case any application is preferred by the applicant under the aforesaid Rules, the court/authority concerned shall be obliged under law to pass an appropriate order in accordance with law at the earliest.
It is hereby directed that all the courts and authorities shall act in aid of the Rules for Video Conferencing for Court in the State of Uttar Pradesh, 2020.

Order Date :- 13.5.2024 SFH  Farjana Begam vs State Of U.P. And Another on 13 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110803688/
